description: Return API key usage information for the authenticated IBAN-Test MCP user. Returns current request limit, requests used today and total requests. Register or log in to create an API key: https://www.iban-test.eu/Registration. Configured free limit: 10 API requests per 24-hour period.
name: get_usage_info
